An '''urtya''' was a traditional [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken]] hut. Made of [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] hide and ancient wood from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] long-gone [[Forest/Legends|forests]], urtyas could be easily folded and transported via bantha, thus accounting for the nomadic habits of the Sandpeople. Inside each urtya, individual Tuskens usually kept [[Bone/Legends|skulls]] of their ancestors and precious [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|krayt dragon pearls]]. When Tusken Raiders set these tents up for what would be long periods in the hottest seasons of Tatooine, they would strengthen the material with layers of bantha spittle.
